# Poimandres Extended

Poimandres Extended is a minimal, frameless dark theme that the description frames as emphasizing semantic meaning over color variety. Errors, voids and deletes are colored red, types are muted so that code stands out, and new items are highlighted in green. Typography and checkbox styles are configured through Style Settings.

![Poimandres Extended screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bastiangx/poimandres.obsidian/HEAD/sc.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Poimandres Extended"
    author: "bastiangx"
    repo:   "bastiangx/poimandres.obsidian"
    slug:   "poimandres-extended"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/poimandres-extended"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/bastiangx/poimandres.obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bastiangx/poimandres.obsidian/HEAD/sc.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a minimal, frameless dark theme that emphasizes semantic meaning over color variety. Color errors, voids and deletes in red, mute types to spotlight code, and highlight new items in green for clearer syntax focus. Configure typography and checkbox styles via Style Settings."
}
```
